AttributeOf.description: The name of the attribute that this attribute extends.

AttributeTypeName.description: The name of the type for the attribute.

AutoNumberFormat.description: Defines the output string format of an autonumber value.

CanBeSecuredForCreate.description: Whether field-level security can be applied to prevent a user from adding data to this attribute.

CanBeSecuredForRead.description: Whether field-level security can be applied to prevent a user from viewing data from this attribute.

CanBeSecuredForUpdate.description: Whether field-level security can be applied to prevent a user from updating data for this attribute.

CanModifyAdditionalSettings.description: Whether any settings not controlled by managed properties can be changed.

ColumnNumber.description: An organization-specific ID for the attribute used for auditing.

DeprecatedVersion.description: The Microsoft Dynamics 365 version that the attribute was deprecated in.

Description.description: The label containing the description for the attribute.

DisplayName.description: A label containing the display name for the attribute.

EntityLogicalName.description: The logical name of the entity that contains the attribute.

ExternalName.description: The external name of an object, typically based on it's name in it's original source.

HasChanged.description: Indicates whether the item of metadata has changed.

IntroducedVersion.description: A string identifying the solution version that the solution component was added in.

IsAuditEnabled.description: Whether the attribute is enabled for auditing.

IsCustomAttribute.description: Whether the attribute is a custom attribute.

IsDataSourceSecret.description: Whether is data source secret is enabled.

IsLogical.description: Whether the attribute is a logical attribute.

IsManaged.description: Whether the attribute is part of a managed solution.

IsPrimaryId.description: Whether the attribute represents the unique identifier for the record.

IsPrimaryName.description: Whether the attribute represents the primary attribute for the entity.

IsRenameable.description: Whether the attribute display name can be changed.

IsRequiredForForm.description: Whether the attribute must be included in a form in a model-driven app.

IsSecured.description: Whether the attribute is secured for field-level security.

IsValidForAdvancedFind.description: Whether the attribute appears in Advanced Find.

IsValidForCreate.description: Whether the value can be set when a record is created.

IsValidForForm.description: Whether the column can be added to a form in a model-driven app.

IsValidForGrid.description: Whether the attribute can be included in a view.

IsValidForRead.description: Whether the value can be retrieved.

IsValidForUpdate.description: Whether the value can be updated.

IsValidODataAttribute.description: Whether the attribute represents a property that is available in the Web API.

LinkedAttributeId.description: The id of the attribute that is linked between appointments and recurring appointments.

LogicalName.description: The logical name for the attribute.

MetadataId.description: A unique identifier for the metadata item.

ModifiedOn.description: When the column was last modified.

RequiredLevel.description: The property that determines the data entry requirement level enforced for the attribute.

SchemaName.description: The schema name for the attribute.

SourceType.description: A value that indicates the source type for a specialized column: formula, calculated, rollup, or prompt.
